_comment: Knockback focus (#688): an attack-order subtype that trades damage for a much bigger, more probable push-back (UnitCombat.KNOCKBACK_FOCUS_DAMAGE_MULT / SoldierCombat.KNOCKBACK_FOCUS_IMPULSE_MULT). Standard 5v5 spawn (no custom scenario override): the player Infantry (uid 1) is selected, given a right-click attack-move order onto its opposite-number enemy Infantry (uid 6), THEN switched to Knockback focus (Ctrl+Equal) -- a fresh move/attack order resets order_mode to NORMAL (Battle._apply_order_cmd's `if not append: u.order_mode = mode`), so the stance has to be applied via a later stance-only order, same as the wedge-charge demo's pattern. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd. World coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).

overlap.reason: Focused knockback drives uid5 into a compressed knot around the strike target; measured min neighbour 0.63 wu on the re-pinned 2x-default layout (was cited lower pre-repin). Transient press compression at the focal point, not standing interpenetration. uid 8 (team 1's 80-horse cavalry): an order at tick 361, out of contact, finds its grid 88.4 degrees off its heading. On main 799b0bca the order re-squares it in one tick (an 88-degree grid turn) and shape_residual fails (86.3 against 30 on every seed). Since #1852 the whole 88.4 degrees is a residue turned out after the heading at the bounded grid rate, through the chase's pivots from tick 381 (at sim commit e55342c1 the pivots' own turn counts against that rate, and the grid's turn builds at the bounded acceleration). Here the chase pivots the same way the grid turns, so the grid closes about 3 degrees a second and still stands 71.6 degrees off at tick 660; at 67cbaa99 the chase pivoted the other way and the grid closed about 12 degrees a second. Two horses pass within 0.38 wu of each other at tick 648, out of contact and not engaged, with the heading steady. Dense 2-tick FULL dumps, all exemptions removed, seeds 0 to 4, Windows: overlap 0.38, 0.42, 0.47, 0.48 and 1.03 against the 5.0 wu floor at sim commit e55342c1; main passes overlap (10.6) on every seed. Measured 2026-10-23.

shape_residual.reason: Team 1's cavalry squadron (uid 8, 9 ranks, 960 wu deep) now deploys with its front rank on its line and marches a long diagonal toward its target, so the deep block spends the clip mid-turn and its rear ranks trail its grid: the same deep-block mid-turn mechanism declared for uid 8 in cycle-charge.json (#1546). CI website demo-diff on PR #1677: worst 87.45 wu against the 30 wu floor, merge-base 3.193.
